page_note: Two structural units. Unit 1 (segs 0-18) is dominated by Manichaean ecclesial liturgical material — fifty-day Pentecost fasts, catechumens, Sundays/Kyriake, apostolic fasting biography, Christ's temptation by devil at Simon's house — used to ground contemporary church practice in cosmological types (First/Second Man). Damage is severe (86.2%). Unit 2 begins Chapter 110 'Concerning the food of man' — substrate cosmological teaching about powers/roots in food, myriad seals, archonic numerics, and purification. The chapter heading is substantive cosmological topic-marking. Editorial fatigue score is negative because Unit 2 reverts to substrate teaching after Unit 1's ecclesial saturation — this is a STRUCTURAL division, not fatigue.
